description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarFieldDownload, which extends the base class SugarFieldBase. It provides functionality to handle download fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, specifically generating a URL-encoded filename for display in detail views.

classes.name: SugarFieldDownload
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldBase, responsible for rendering download link details in views.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates the detail view for the download field by encoding the filename and rendering the appropriate Smarty template.
